contact_id.description: hash key; FK into modules/contacts/ — the person being paid. the rate book joins to the contact, not a duplicate person record

role.description: range key; the role this row prices (e.g. "barista", "bookkeeper"). one row per (contact_id, role) — a lawyer who also bookkeeps is two rows

rate.description: pay rate for this role. hourly for W-2; the close-handler resolves it at clock-out (hours × rate) — never copied onto the time-entry

classification.description: tax classification. W-2 comp flows through labor (accrual → withholding → W-2); 1099 never enters labor (contractor pay is AP / invoicing)

location.description: the worker's home location ordinal (settings LOCATION# rows). defaults to "1" (main) at put; pay-run withholding dims stamp it; a time-entry's own location wins for the shift it covers

ytd_wages_at_cutover.description: migration only: gross wages the OLD system paid this person Jan 1 → cutover_date. pay_run adds it to the YTD the wage-base caps (SS/FUTA/SUTA) read, for runs in the cutover's calendar year. per-person — set it on ONE role row

cutover_date.description: migration only: the cutover date (YYYY-MM-DD) scoping ytd_wages_at_cutover — the amount counts only for pay periods in this calendar year

worker_id.description: hash key; the worker who clocked in (the contact_id half of the worker row)

entry_id.description: range key; <started_at>#<location>#<id> — time-leading so a worker's entries sort chronologically, location ordinal spottable in the key. legacy bare-uuid entries read as location "1"

location.description: where the shift happened (location ordinal) — captured at clock-in, defaulted from the worker row. the close-handler stamps it into the wage accrual's journal dimensions

role.description: the role worked this entry; resolves to a worker row's rate at close

ended_at.description: ms-epoch clock-out. Absent = still open (durably held until closed)

status.description: lifecycle. "closed" (ended_at set) triggers the stream → close-handler accrual

job.description: optional job tag on a time entry; the close-handler copies it into the wage accrual's dimensions for per-job labor cost

task_id.description: optional task reference on a time entry (a modules/tasks task_id); the close-handler copies it into the wage accrual's dimensions.task — cost per task is a statement slice, and fix work logged against a class task IS the class's fix cost

worker_id.description: hash key; the worker this legal record belongs to (many-to-one with worker)

sk.description: range key; composite role#type (e.g. "barista#W-4"). per-role, not aggregated — two W-2 roles are two W-2 rows

type.description: legal document / election type carried in this row — free-form (e.g. W-4, W-2, 941, 1099, I-9, DE-4, PASSPORT, DL). the agent sets it from the current requirements it looks up, not a maintained enum of every federal/state/foreign form

value.description: typed JSON for the document. agent-managed (HR over chat); the SSN is masked here (XXX-XX-1234) — the raw SSN / bank account live in the secure store, injected by the emitter only at filing / ACH
